properties.name: West Divide Water Conservancy District
properties.label: West Divide Water Conservancy
properties.caveat: Real official FULL district boundary from Colorado DOLA, 7/28/26. Cleaned 7/29/26: source MultiPolygon had 40 parts - the main 1998.6 km2 district plus one 5.65 km2 secondary piece, and 38 tiny sliver fragments (0.67 km2 down to sub-hectare specks), mostly hugging river/stream corridors (district boundaries are commonly drawn along stream centerlines, and digitizing slivers accumulate along those same lines) - rendered as scattered artifacts on the map. Dropped anything under 1.0 km2 as likely digitizing noise, kept the two significant pieces. Still pending a sanity-check with the district itself (state-maintained special-district data can trace back to old scanned drawings). Cleaned 7/30/26: dropped 36 tiny interior holes/slivers left over from the DOLA source geometry - kept exterior ring(s) only, since a municipal/district boundary has no legitimate internal exclaves. CLIPPED 7/30/26 to the Roaring Fork HUC-8 watershed for display - this is NOT the legal boundary. Real extent is the full West Divide district (~2,005 sq km); 1,467 sq km lies outside the watershed and was removed. Project scope is the Roaring Fork watershed only.

properties.name: Town of Carbondale
properties.label: Carbondale
properties.caveat: Water supply: Crystal River, substantial water rights (per Gwen, 7/28/26). Cleaned 7/30/26: dropped 5 tiny interior holes/slivers left over from the DOLA source geometry - kept exterior ring(s) only, since a municipal/district boundary has no legitimate internal exclaves.

properties.name: City of Aspen
properties.label: Aspen
properties.caveat: Water supply: Maroon & Castle Creeks; new storage planned at Woody Creek (per Gwen, 7/28/26). Cleaned 7/29/26: dropped 2 sub-hectare sliver fragments (0.0021 and 0.0001 km2) from the source MultiPolygon, kept the main 9.95 km2 city boundary. Cleaned 7/30/26: dropped 11 tiny interior holes/slivers left over from the DOLA source geometry - kept exterior ring(s) only, since a municipal/district boundary has no legitimate internal exclaves.

properties.name: City of Glenwood Springs
properties.label: Glenwood Springs
properties.caveat: Water supply: Grizzly & No Name creeks, some Roaring Fork rights (per Gwen, 7/28/26). Cleaned 7/29/26: dropped 3 tiny fragments (0.016, 0.0011, and one literally zero-area) from the source MultiPolygon, kept the main 15.38 km2 city boundary. Cleaned 7/30/26: dropped 8 tiny interior holes/slivers left over from the DOLA source geometry - kept exterior ring(s) only, since a municipal/district boundary has no legitimate internal exclaves. CLIPPED 7/30/26 to the Roaring Fork HUC-8 watershed for display - this is NOT the legal boundary. Real extent is the full City of Glenwood Springs municipal boundary (~15.5 sq km); 9 sq km lies outside the watershed and was removed. Project scope is the Roaring Fork watershed only.

properties.name: Town of Basalt
properties.label: Basalt
properties.caveat: Real official municipal boundary from Colorado DOLA, 7/28/26. ~5.2 sq km. Straddles Eagle/Pitkin/Garfield county lines - included since it sits within the Roaring Fork watershed and RFWSD/MVMD both serve it. Cleaned 7/30/26: dropped 19 tiny interior holes/slivers left over from the DOLA source geometry - kept exterior ring(s) only, since a municipal/district boundary has no legitimate internal exclaves.
